name: Dreamscape
source:
You decide to do an online ritual that promises to "grant your deepest desire" fully not expecting it to work but when you go to sleep that night you find yourself speaking to a mysterious man claiming to be a... demon? He claims to be able to grant your wish but wants your soul in exchange.

How far are you willing to go for your wish?

[From [url=https://hexid.itch.io/dreamscape]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你决定进行一个在线仪式，承诺“满足你最深的愿望”，完全没想到它会起作用，但当你那天晚上睡觉时，你发现自己正在和一个自称是……恶魔的神秘男人说话？他声称能够实现你的愿望，但想要交换你的灵魂。

为了自己的愿望，你愿意走多远？

[来自[url=https://hexid.itch.io/dreamscape]Itch.io[/url]]
